objective: Defeat Mok'Morokk and report the news to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.

description: You tell me when ready for good beating.
progress: I thought you were going to attempt to drive Mok'Morokk out of the village. Instead you have come to me to chat?
completion: That cowardly fat mass Mok'Morokk fled like a scared child. You have done a great service, <name>.
Now my people can appoint a new leader, one who will help us reclaim our old home once and for all.
